info.title: Asset Portfolio Dashboard API
info.description: Read API behind the asset portfolio dashboard: portfolio snapshot, assets, history, refinancing, remarketing, vendors and data sources. Live updates are pushed over SignalR at /hubs/dashboard (server messages 'Snapshot' and 'PortfolioEvent'; client method 'SetFilter'). Training exercise on synthetic data; not related to any business.

get.description: All headline figures and breakdowns for the overview: exposure, collateral, loan-to-value, arrears, forced-sale shortfall, by asset class, delinquency buckets, remarketing, top vendors and countries. The same object is pushed live over SignalR (/hubs/dashboard, message 'Snapshot'). Accepts the portfolio filter (assetClass, country, vendorId, productType, underwaterOnly).

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Only this country (ISO code, e.g. NL).

parameters.name: UnderwaterOnly
parameters.description: Only contracts whose exposure exceeds the market value of their collateral.

get.description: The last 50 portfolio events (payments, defaults, revaluations, auctions, refinancing, data loads), oldest first. New events are pushed live over SignalR (message 'PortfolioEvent').
Paged list of financed assets with current values, contract loan-to-value and days past due. Accepts the portfolio filter (assetClass, country, vendorId, productType, underwaterOnly).

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Only this country (ISO code, e.g. NL).

parameters.name: UnderwaterOnly
parameters.description: Only contracts whose exposure exceeds the market value of their collateral.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on serial number, category or contract number.

get.description: Same query as 'List assets', streamed as a CSV download (up to 100.000 rows). Accepts the portfolio filter (assetClass, country, vendorId, productType, underwaterOnly).

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Only this country (ISO code, e.g. NL).

parameters.name: UnderwaterOnly
parameters.description: Only contracts whose exposure exceeds the market value of their collateral.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on serial number, category or contract number.

get.description: One asset with its contract, customer, vendor and full valuation history; each valuation point carries the asset's share of the contract balance at that date, from the repayment schedule.

One point per day: exposure, collateral, forced sale value, loan-to-value, 30+ and 90+ days past due, net recoveries. Older points are a synthetic backfill (isBackfilled = true); today's point is live.

parameters.name: assetClass
parameters.description: Only this asset class; omit for the whole portfolio.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days back from today, 1–3650.

Accepts the portfolio filter (assetClass, country, vendorId, productType, underwaterOnly).

parameters.name: Country

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Only this country (ISO code, e.g. NL).

parameters.name: UnderwaterOnly

get.description: One vendor: performance, 24 months of origination, mix by asset class and product, delinquency and top customers.
Upstream systems feeding the dashboard, with last load, freshness (Fresh / Late / Stale against the expected interval), 7-day success rate, rows loaded in 24 hours and average load duration.
Loads newest first, with duration, rows read and rejected, and the failure or warning message.
Vendors and countries for filter dropdowns.
Whether the market simulator (stand-in for the client's systems) is producing live changes.

post.description: Stops live changes; the dashboard keeps showing the last figures.

AgeingBucket.description: Unsold repossessed stock by days since repossession.

AssetClass.description: Broad equipment segments typical for a vendor-finance portfolio.

AssetClassStat.description: Exposure and collateral of one asset class; LoanToValue = exposure ÷ market value.

AssetDetail.description: One asset with its contract, customer, vendor and valuation history.

AssetListItem.description: One financed asset as listed in the asset explorer.

AuctionItem.description: An auction with lot statistics; SellThrough = sold ÷ (sold + passed in).

ChannelRecovery.description: Sales and recovery through one channel in the last 12 months.

ClassRecovery.description: Sales and recovery for one asset class in the last 12 months.

CountryStat.description: Active assets and their market value in one country.

DelinquencyBucket.description: Contracts and exposure in one days-past-due bucket.

ExpectedLossByClass.description: Exposure and expected loss (PD × LGD × exposure) of one asset class.

HistoryPoint.description: Portfolio figures on one day; IsBackfilled marks generated history.

LoadRunItem.description: One load from a source system.

MaturityQuarter.description: Exposure on contracts maturing in a quarter, and the balloon / residual amounts due then.

MonthlyOrigination.description: New contracts and financed amount in one month.

PagedResultOfAssetListItem.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PagedResultOfAuctionItem.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PagedResultOfLoadRunItem.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PagedResultOfRefinancingCandidate.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PagedResultOfRefinancingRequestItem.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PagedResultOfRemarketingCaseItem.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PagedResultOfVendorPerformance.description: One page of results; Total counts all matching rows.

PortfolioEvent.description: A single change in the portfolio, streamed to the live event feed.

key.description: Stable identity, used as the SignalR group name for connections sharing this filter.

PortfolioFilter.description: Global dashboard filter. Every field is optional; an empty filter means the whole portfolio.

PortfolioSnapshot.description: Everything the dashboard needs in one message; pushed to clients over SignalR.

ReasonStat.description: Requests and decisions for one refinancing reason.

RecourseType.description: What the vendor guarantees if the customer defaults.

RefinancingCandidate.description: An open contract worth a refinancing conversation: maturing soon, balloon due, underwater or in arrears.

RefinancingRequestItem.description: A refinancing request with the risk picture at request time and the decision.

RefinancingSummary.description: Refinancing pipeline, expected loss and maturity wall for the filtered portfolio.

RemarketingCaseItem.description: A repossessed asset on its way to sale, with costs and recovery.

RemarketingStat.description: Repossession pipeline counts and recovery on sold assets.

RemarketingSummary.description: Recovery pipeline, stock ageing, recovery rates, costs and upcoming auctions.

SimulatorState.description: Whether the market simulator is producing live changes.

SourceStatus.description: An upstream source system with its latest load, freshness and reliability.

ValuationPoint.description: One valuation of an asset, with the asset's share of the contract balance at that date.

VendorDetail.description: One vendor with origination history, mixes, delinquency and top customers.

VendorMix.description: Contracts and exposure in one category (asset class, product or customer).

VendorPerformance.description: A vendor programme: terms, exposure, risk and origination against target.

VendorStat.description: A vendor ranked by exposure on open contracts.
